name: Dak Nong food guide
summary: Cơm lam, grilled meat, and canh thụt are the festival meal. Grilled Serepok catfish is the plate the tourism portal put in the Top 100 for 2020 and 2021. The jar is for a ceremony or a guest. A price is Check on arrival.
body: Split the bamboo, or peel the banana leaf, and eat the sticky rice with grilled meat and chili salt. The catfish from the Serepok comes wrapped in a forest leaf. When the jar is open, one bamboo straw goes around the circle.

The 2024 visitor handbook on the Dak Nong provincial portal and VnExpress’s handbook of 10 Sep 2023 cook cơm lam in a bamboo or nứa tube. Bao Lam Dong, on 22 Sep 2023, grills the M'Nong rice in a banana leaf and says beans may go into the rice. Canh thụt has three ingredient lists: those handbooks, VnExpress on 2 Jun 2021, and Bao Lam Dong. Each list is under the tube soup.

Sunday at Đắk R'Măng, in Đắk Glong, the handbook puts thắng cố and corn wine on the Hmong stalls. The opening hour is Check on arrival. So is every price below. Da Lat’s charcoal bánh căn is a different meal.
specialtiesLead: Start with the festival rice, the grilled meat, the tube soup, and the jar. The Serepok catfish is the named specialty.

sections.heading: The highland table
paragraphs: These are the M'Nong, Ma, and Ede plates the provincial handbook, the tourism portal, VnExpress, and Bao Lam Dong name. Where the accounts disagree, each one is under the line.

spots.name: Bamboo-tube rice
spots.note: Glutinous rice at festivals and gatherings. The 2024 handbook and VnExpress’s 10 Sep 2023 handbook soak the rice, pack it into bamboo or nứa with stream water, and burn the tube or bury it in coals. The charred shell splits away and the center is white. Bao Lam Dong says M'Nong cooks may mix in beans, wrap the rice in banana leaf, and grill it, and that the leaf stays green. Eat it with the grilled meat. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled meat
spots.note: The handbook says the meat, from livestock or poultry, is mostly unseasoned, skewered over coals or cooked in a lồ ô tube, and dipped in chili salt. At Hội Xuân Liêng Nung the tourism portal names unsalted grilled pork beside the rice. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled Serepok catfish
spots.note: Red-tailed catfish from the Serepok through Krong No and Cu Jut. The tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, and the handbook wrap it in a forest leaf, grill it, and dip it in salt of lemongrass, green chili, and forest leaves. Eat it with cơm lam. Both call it a Top 100 specialty for 2020 and 2021. They also name om, chả, steaming, garlic stir-fry, and cháo as other ways to cook the same fish. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Grilled snakehead
spots.note: The tourism portal’s 11 Jan 2023 account of Hội Xuân Liêng Nung serves cá lóc, also called cá quả, with cơm lam, unsalted grilled pork, and canh thụt. A marinade was not printed. The same article also writes the festival name Liên Nung. The year’s civil date is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Tube soup
spots.note: The tourism portal and the handbook call it an old M'Nong soup and stir it with chopsticks in a bamboo or nứa tube. Their list is lá bép (lá nhíp), palm shoots, bitter eggplant, and stream fish, plus lòng non, pork ribs, or canned fish. VnExpress on 2 Jun 2021 lists rau nhíp, bamboo shoots, meat or stream fish, a few termites, and mole crickets, cooked in a sealed fresh lồ ô tube that is tilted and turned, then mashed with a thorny rattan strip. Bao Lam Dong lists palm shoots, bép, bitter eggplant, chili, and dried stream fish or pork ribs, seasoned with salt and MSG, mashed with a stick in a long lồ ô internode. The Đắk Nia commune site calls it Biếp Prung. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Jar wine
spots.note: The tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, ferments rice, rice husk, and yeast from forest leaves and bark in a jar, without distilling. The jar is for festivals, important days in the bon, and for guests. One bent bamboo straw passes from host to guest. VnExpress says M'Nong wine uses leaves, roots, bark, gạo nếp cái hoa vàng, brown rice, or local rice, fermented two to six months, until it is thick like honey and brown-yellow. A strength is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Chicken with sour bamboo
spots.note: VnExpress, 2 Jun 2021, says Ma cooks sour the sliced bamboo shoots in a salt jar for about two weeks, squeeze them dry, and stir them into seasoned chicken over an even fire for about 30 to 45 minutes. Crushed forest pepper goes on at the end. A restaurant was not named. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Wrapped nuc nac
spots.note: Bao Lam Dong names gói quả núc nác as an Ede dish and does not print a filling or a cook time. A method is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bitter-eggplant salad
spots.note: Bao Lam Dong says this salad of bitter eggplant and dried fish stays on restaurant menus in the province. A dressing was not printed. A door was not named. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Bep leaf with canned fish
spots.note: Bao Lam Dong names this among plates restaurants adapted from the older cooking, beside cơm lam, grilled meat, jar wine, and canh thụt. A simmer time was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Palm shoot with bep leaf
spots.note: The same Bao Lam Dong paragraph names palm shoots stir-fried with bep leaf. A fat and a time were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: What to carry home
paragraphs: The handbook’s gift list, which cites VnExpress, and the tourism portal’s own posts. A bag price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dak Nong coffee
spots.note: The tourism portal, 16 Mar 2022, names café vối robusta grown on basalt and does not print a brew. The handbook also names Arabica and Culi. In Tuy Đức the portal puts coffee and pepper at Quảng Tân and Đắk R'tíh. A cup price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dak N'rung pepper
spots.note: The handbook says the berries are large, round, plump, and fragrant, and that white pepper is packed as a gift. A shop was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dried macadamia
spots.note: The tourism portal’s dried-macadamia post says growers skip herbicide, chemical pesticide, and heavy inorganic fertilizer. The same office says more than 1,000 hectares grow at Quảng Trực in Tuy Đức. A bag price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dak Mil butter avocado
spots.note: The handbook says the skin is thin and smooth, and the ripe flesh is yellow-green, sticky, fragrant, and without fiber. A season was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Buon Choah rice
spots.note: Rice from Buôn Choáh in Krong No, spelled Buôn Choah on the tourism portal. The portal calls the commune the province’s largest rice bowl, on volcanic soil with mineral-rich irrigation, grown to VietGAP, fragrant, sticky, and deeply sweet. A bag price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Durian
spots.note: The tourism portal says the harvest runs from April to September, names Ri 6, Út Thủy from Ben Tre, and Monthong from Thailand, all with VietGAP, and points to trang trại Gia Trung in Gia Nghia and to Đắk Mil. The handbook says the fruit to buy grows mainly on red basalt in Đắk Mil and does not print that season. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Cam sanh
spots.note: The tourism portal says cam sành from the organic cooperative at Quảng Phú, Krong No, holds a provincial OCOP rank of 4 stars, and that guests taste the fruit in the garden. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Quyt duong
spots.note: Named with cam sành as the other 4-star provincial OCOP fruit at Quảng Phú. A sugar level was not printed. A price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Kitchens from the north
paragraphs: Bao Lam Dong, on 22 Sep 2023, says Tay, Dao, and Mong communities who settled in Dak Nong still cook these dishes. The article says Dao cooking runs past 60 dishes and Mong cooking is about 20, and it names the plates below. A method that was not printed is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Five-colour sticky rice
spots.note: A Tay dish on that list. The leaves that colour the rice were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Mac mat roast pork
spots.note: Tay roast pork with mắc mật. A cut and a fire were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Fish mam
spots.note: Tay fish mam. A fish and a ferment time were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Sour fish
spots.note: Tay sour fish, listed with the mam. A pickle was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ginger turmeric chicken soup
spots.nameVi: Thịt gà giò nấu canh gừng nghệ
spots.note: Tay soup of chicken drumstick with ginger and turmeric. A simmer time was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Banh gio
spots.note: A Tay cake on the same list. A wrapper and a filling were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hoang wine
spots.note: One of three Dao specialties the article names. A grain and a strength were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Ginger chicken
spots.note: Dao chicken stir-fried with ginger. A cut and a time were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Salt-soured meat
spots.note: Dao salt-soured meat. A cut and a number of days were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Men men
spots.note: A Mong dish named with thắng cố and corn wine. A grain and a steam were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Thang co
spots.note: The handbook puts thắng cố on the Sunday stalls at Đắk R'Măng. Bao Lam Dong also names it at the market in Đắk Som. A meat and a herb list for this pot were not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Corn wine
spots.note: Mong corn wine from mountain corn and leaf yeast, distilled by hand. Bao Lam Dong says the strength is heavier or lighter depending on how much wine is drawn. A proof is Check on arrival. The handbook sells it at the Sunday market in Đắk R'Măng.

spots.name: Banh day
spots.note: Bao Lam Dong says visitors eat this Mong cake at the markets in Đắk R'Măng and Đắk Som. A dough was not printed. A price is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Hang chu wine
spots.note: Cooked from the germ of glutinous or ordinary rice. Bao Lam Dong says it is kept for the new year and for weddings. A strength is Check on arrival.

sections.heading: Sunday market
paragraphs: One sourced market. The opening hour is Check on arrival.

spots.name: Dak R'Mang Sunday market
spots.note: The 2024 handbook says the Hmong market on the M'Nong plateau opens every Sunday and sells textiles, household goods, medicinal plants, tools, and the specialties thắng cố and rượu ngô. The opening hour is Check on arrival. Bao Lam Dong also names a market at Đắk Som, in the same district, for thắng cố and bánh dày, and does not print a day for it.

seoTitle: Dak Nong food guide — tube rice, Serepok catfish, jar wine
seoDescription: Cơm lam, grilled meat, canh thụt, and Serepok catfish, plus the Sunday market at Đắk R'Măng. Where accounts disagree, each one is printed. A price is Check on arrival.
